stances.summary: Calls Pete Hegseth unfit as Defense Secretary, lacking strategy
stances.quote:
Our troops deserve a Secretary of Defense who doesn’t just thank them for their service, but gives them a plan, a strategy and an endgame so they can safely return home to their families.
 
Pete Hegseth is a failure.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump leaving troops in indefinite Iran deployment
stances.quote:
No more extended deployments without end. 
 
Our troops will always answer the call, but an incompetent President leaving them stranded and living in uncertainty in a war he can’t end is complete bullshit.

stances.summary: Demands public hearing on troops' extended Iran deployments
stances.quote:
Across our Navy, Army, Air Force and beyond, the Trump Administration is failing our brave troops who are forced to carry out extended deployments in this never-ending Iran War.

This cannot continue. They must answer to the American people in a public hearing immediately.

stances.summary: Criticizes renaming USS Doris Miller as narcissistic insult
stances.quote:
Doris Miller was an American hero who ran toward danger. Donald Trump was a draft dodger who ran from service.

Replacing Miller’s name with Trump’s is an insult to a historic legacy of courage and sacrifice, all to feed one man’s ego.

stances.summary: Holds Trump and Hegseth accountable for USS Lincoln troop mistreatment
stances.quote:
What our troops endured aboard the USS Lincoln is unforgivable. Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth must answer for this egregious lack of planning.

Our servicemembers cannot keep paying the price for their failures. https://t.co/0iS2XLjwNQ

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump's military readiness and troop welfare standards
stances.quote:
Rotted food. Moldy showers. Broken plumbing.
 
Trump wouldn’t last a day.

stances.summary: Demands Secretary Hegseth address USS Lincoln crew conditions and Pentagon denial
stances.quote:
Troops aboard the USS Lincoln have been at sea for nearly nine months. Their families are describing severe exhaustion, rotten food, broken toilets—and the Pentagon is denouncing their cries as “fake news.”
 
Secretary Hegseth, how could you let this happen?

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for troop exhaustion, adversary exploitation, Iran diversion
stances.quote:
Our troops are exhausted and our adversaries are watching Trump pull back and divert our forces toward Iran. With no end in sight.

We are increasingly less and less safe under this President’s incompetence.

stances.summary: Opposes Hegseth as Defense Secretary, demands his firing
stances.quote:
If he's really grateful, he'd grow a spine. But no, he will literally say anything to downplay the war and suck up to Trump's ego while our warriors pay the price.

Hegseth is incompetent and must be fired.

stances.summary: Opposes casualty record manipulation, proposes legislative protection for troops
stances.quote:
Trump is manipulating casualty records to try and hide the true cost of his illegal war from the American people.
 
I refuse to let him.
 
My Honoring the Sacrifices of Troops in War Act would ban the Pentagon from doing this, restore our heroes' records and protect their benefit

stances.summary: Demands Boeing safety fix applied to all MAX variants
stances.quote:
NEWS: After demanding that the FAA deny Boeing's waiver for a safety flaw on its 737 MAX 7 back in 2024, the FAA has now certified the aircraft with a fix for the issue.
 
Safety should always come first, and this fix must be included on every Boeing MAX variant. No matter what.

stances.summary: Defends women in military, criticizes Hegseth's gender-based attacks
stances.quote:
Our nation would never be battle-ready without our brave women in uniform who have earned their place in our military. Pete Hegseth's attacks only weaken our readiness.
 
Our WARRIOR Act would ensure every servicemember is judged by their ability, not their gender.

19thnews.org/

Two years after Trump promised to deliver “free IVF” if he was elected, he has yet to deliver.
 
I have a bill that could get it done immediately.

Let’s pass my Right to IVF Act. https://t.co/UWYo650tvL

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for not delivering promised IVF affordability

IVF has become so unaffordable that people are literally flying to Greece to have a shot at starting a family.

Where is the “free IVF” that Trump promised??

https://t.co/jy7p1adWdq

stances.summary: Opposes Virginia abortion ban denying veteran health care

Under Donald Trump, our VA has one of the most restrictive abortion bans in the country—denying Veterans care even in cases of rape, incest or serious health risks.

Politicians have no business interfering in the personal health decisions of those who served.

https://t.co/JTj3y

stances.summary: Opposes Trump administration restricting women's reproductive rights
stances.quote:
Women waited too long and fought too damn hard to let anyone in the White House take away our rights.

Happy Women’s Equality Day.

stances.summary: Criticizes broken promise on free IVF access

Hm, you'd think the self-proclaimed "Father of IVF" who promised free IVF would shut this down.
 
But he hasn't.

stances.summary: Defends IVF access, calls for GOP support and affordability measures

My two girls are only here because of IVF—but for far too many Americans, this treatment is out of reach.

No more excuses from Republicans. It's time to protect IVF and make it more affordable for middle class families.

Trump's ICE arrested the wife of Army Sgt. Hedcar Leonel Turcios Juarez in front of their 6-year-old.

How can we expect our troops to be at their best when their Commander in Chief is deporting their loved ones at home?

This is no way to honor our heroes

stances.summary: Condemns deportation of soldier's father as betrayal

Joshua Aviles spent more than 9 months at sea serving our country. While he was away, Trump arrested his father.

There is no higher betrayal to our heroes than to have a family member deported by the same nation they sacrificed to defend.
 
This has to stop.

https://t.co/08A1Re

stances.summary: Celebrates immigration, frames diversity as national strength

While our brave servicemembers are sacrificing to keep us safe, Donald Trump is deporting their families.

We're leading an investigation. This betrayal has to stop.

stances.summary: Opposes deportation of military families, calls policy cruel and unsafe

There is no greater betrayal to our troops than their own family being deported by the same nation they sacrificed to defend.

You can't ask our heroes to focus on the mission while their spouse or kid is locked up, marked for deportation.

It's cruel and makes us all less safe.

Getting your kids ready for school shouldn’t mean going into debt.

First war with Iran, now trade war with Canada. Trump’s priorities are clear: Make himself richer, make everything more expensive, hurt American businesses and force middle-class families to pay the price.

American families can’t afford another Trump-made price hike.

End. The. War.
